title: Sunvisor Radiant Moisturizing Face Sunscreen SPF 35

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, hyaluronicAcid, mineral, fragranceFree

descriptionHtml:
✓ Hydrating✓ Clean + Planet Aware✓ Reef Safe SPF✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Vitamin C✓ Zinc SPF

What it is: A radiant face sunscreen with 100% Mineral Non Nano Zinc Oxide SPF 35, active levels of encapsulated vitamin C, and sheer golden pearl.


Skin Type: Normal, Dry, and Combination


Skincare Concerns: Dryness and Dullness


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Licorice: Brightening extract helps protect from discoloration after sun exposure.

- Hyaluronic Acid: Plumps and moisturizes for lasting hydration.

- Aloe Vera: Soothes irritation.


Ingredient Callouts: This product is cruelty-free, reef-safe, and comes in recyclable packaging.

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:

-Begin with cleansed skin and pump Sunvisor onto your fingertips.

-Warm Sunvisor between your fingertips for 10 seconds or more. The longer you warm it up, the more transparent it will appear.

-Apply liberally and massage Sunvisor into your skin.

-Out in the sun? Reapply every two hours for full SPF coverage.


Recycling Instructions:

-The Sunvisor tube is made of 100% Sugarcane Bioresin, a carbon neutral and renewable derivative of the Brazilian sugarcane plant.

-Once your Sunvisor tube is empty, trim the end of the tube and give it a clean out before placing it in your home recycling bin.

-You can recycle the pump and cap through our partnership with Pact Collective: https://bit.ly/3QKdhuj

Ingredients+

- Encapsulated Vitamin C: Protects skin against free radicals, boosts collagen, and brightens skin.

- Hyaluronic Acid: Plumps and moisturizes for lasting hydration.

- 100% Mineral Zinc Oxide: Offers clean SPF 35 protection and shields against UVA and UVB rays.


"Active Ingredient: Zinc Oxide (15%) Ingredients: Water, Coco-Caprylate/Caprate, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, C15-19 Alkane, Isocetyl Stearoyl Stearate, Undecane, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Jojoba Esters, Tocopheryl Acetate, Tribehenin, Tridecane, Glyceryl Stearate, Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate, Mica, Titanium Dioxide (CI77891), Glycerin, Lactobacillus, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf, Acacia Senegal Gum, Xanthan Gum, Viola Tricolor Extract, Bisabolol, Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract, Hyaluronic Acid, Glycosphingolipids, GlycolipidsCocos Nucifera (Coconut) Fruit Extract, Symphytum Officinale Leaf Extract, 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, Iron Oxide (CI77492), Iron Oxide (CI77491), Iron Oxide (CI77499), Tin Oxide"




The list of ingredients is subject to change, please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
